name: Allsource
author: Allsource

sections.description:
If you have any questions or concerns about this external dependency, please contact our support team for clarification.

Allsource empowers you to understand user actions and motivations, helping you create better user experiences that drive conversions. With Allsource, you can:

Visualize User Behavior

  • Use heatmaps to see where users click, scroll, and move on your site. This visual data helps you make actionable improvements.

Experience User Journeys

  • Watch recordings of real user interactions to analyze clicks and navigation patterns, identifying pain points and optimizing user flow.

Analyze Conversions

  • Use funnels to visualize conversion paths and pinpoint where users drop off. Review relevant recordings to understand obstacles in the user journey.

Explore Key Metrics

  • Connect numerical data with user behavior insights, easily visualizing important metrics and accessing corresponding recordings and heatmaps.

Gather User Feedback

  • Listen to Your Users: Conduct targeted surveys to gather valuable feedback directly from users, helping you validate ideas and understand their needs.
  • Contextual Feedback: Implement a real-time feedback tool on your site, allowing users to express their thoughts about specific elements, such as pages or forms.

Engage with Users

  • User Interviews Made Easy: Automate the process of recruiting, scheduling, and conducting moderated user interviews, allowing you to focus on meaningful interactions.

Allsource Platform

  • Monitor User Metrics: Use the Dashboard for a comprehensive overview of user data, helping you identify trends and potential issues before they escalate.
  • Seamless Integrations: Connect Allsource with your favorite tools to automate workflows and save time—no coding required.

This plugin provides a straightforward installation of Allsource on your WordPress site. Sign up for your free trial today!
sections.installation:
Simple Installation

You can install the Allsource plugin directly from the WordPress plugin library via your WordPress dashboard. For detailed instructions, refer to our documentation.

Manual Installation

Alternatively, you can install it manually:
– Download the Allsource plugin as a zip file.
– Upload the allsource folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
– Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Configuration

After installation, navigate to Settings and enter your unique Allsource Site ID to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Allsource account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need a Allsource account to access all features, including heatmaps, recordings, and feedback tools. You can sign up for a free account.

What should I do after setting up Allsource?

Enable and manage all Allsource features from the plugin settings. Any changes will be reflected immediately on the site(s) where the Allsource script is installed.

For more information on getting started with Allsource, visit our help center.

Where can I learn more about Allsource?

Visit our website to discover more about Allsource and how it can help you gain insights into user interactions on your site.

What are the Allsource Terms of Service?

The full terms of service are available on our website, along with other legal and privacy documentation. If you have further questions, feel free to reach out to our support.

Is Allsource GDPR compliant?

Yes, Allsource is built with a privacy-by-design approach and offers various compliance controls for GDPR.

Can my users opt-out?

Yes, Allsource respects user privacy preferences, and users can opt-out of tracking as needed.

How do I remove Allsource from my site?

You can uninstall this plugin at any time to remove Allsource from your site. Collected data can be deleted through the plugin interface or by deleting your site or account.
